content.body: i've already enabled it for us, since we're on a free Teams plan
unfortunately open source maintainers who generally aren't, don't have access to policies :-( but i've complained and been told they'll provide a way to apply the policy asap
I'm thinking of creating a "no consensus needed" label for PRs marked as normative but where we are just matching what (we assume) is previous consensus
So that all normative PRs fall into one of the "needs consensus"/"was presented and got explicit consensus"/"no consensus needed" buckets
don't we effectively have this with (the absence of) the "needs consensus" and "has consensus" labels?
also, if you do add it, I'd appreciate if you put a little effort into marking historical cases as well
